question.text: Under PMLA 2002, the PM must report suspicious transactions to FIU-IND within:

explanation.text: The Logic: SEBI AML Master Circular requires STR filing with FIU-IND within 7 working days. The Trap: 24h is too tight; 30 days is too lax.
